source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of X-rays and X-ray imaging (PDF 159-162).

blocks.text: Hydrogen aur doosre halke anasir mein electrons ki tabdeeliyan infrared, nazar aane wali ya ultraviolet mein spectral lakeerein deti hain, kyunke un ke levels ke darmiyan tawanai ka farq chhota hai. Bhari atoms mein electrons K, L, M, N, O waghera naam ke hum-markaz khol (shells) mein hain, K khol nucleus ke sab se qareeb (Fig 20.3). Andaruni khol ke electrons mazbooti se bandhe hain aur unhein nikalne ke liye bohat tawanai chahiye. Excited atom apni aam halat mein wapas aaye to zyada tawanai ke photons nikalte hain: bhari atoms mein andaruni khol ke electrons ki tabdeeliyan zyada tawanai ke photons, X-rays, deti hain. Yeh X-rays khaas wavelengths ki hain aur characteristic X-rays kehlati hain; in ke mutale ne atom ki banawat aur periodic table samajhne mein bohat ahem kirdar ada kiya. Fig 20.4 electromagnetic spectrum mein X-rays ki jagah dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Electromagnetic spectrum ki rangeen patti, baen radio lehron se microwaves, infrared, nazar aane wali roshni aur ultraviolet se hoti hui daen X-rays aur gamma rays tak, us par aisi lehar jis ki wavelength baen se daen ghatti. Taqreebi wavelengths 10^3 m se 10^-12 m tak nishan zada. Teer batata ke daen taraf chhoti wavelength, zyada frequency aur zyada tawanai ke photons.
blocks.caption: Electromagnetic spectrum (Fig 20.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: X-rays ki wavelengths taqreeban 10^-8 se 10^-11 m hain, nazar aane wali roshni se hazaron guna chhoti, is liye har X-ray photon hazaron guna zyada tawanai rakhta hai.

blocks.text: X-rays bohat khali (high vacuum) X-ray tube mein banti hain (Fig 20.5). Cathode C filament F se garam ho kar electrons chhorta hai, jo anode T ki taraf tez kiye jate hain. Agar C aur T ke darmiyan potential difference V ho to electron target se jis zyada se zyada kinetic energy se takrata hai woh (K.E.)max = Ve (20.1) hai. Yeh tez electrons tungsten ya kisi aur bhari element ke target se takrate hain, aur kuch sab se andaruni khol, K ya L, ke electrons nikal dete hain. Agar K khol ka electron nikal jaye aur khala reh jaye to L khol ka electron khala mein koodta aur K-alpha X-ray naam ka photon chhorta hai: h f(K-alpha) = EL - EK (20.2). Is ke bajaye M khol ka electron khala bhar sakta hai, jis se K-beta X-ray milti hai: h f(K-beta) = EM - EK (20.3). Andaruni khol ki tabdeeliyon ke yeh photons characteristic X-rays kehlate hain, kyunke un ki tawanaiyan target ke maddah par munhasir hain. L aur M khol mein bane khala oonchi levels ke electrons bharte hain, jis se mazeed X-rays banti hain. Characteristic X-rays musalsal spectrum par alag lakeeron ki shakal mein nazar aati hain (Fig 20.6).

blocks.alt: Baen: K, L, M aur N khol ke dashed dairon se ghira nucleus. Neeche baen se tez electron aa kar K electron nikal deta (oopar baen teer); L khol ka electron khala mein girta (sabz teer) aur K-alpha X-ray photon (purple lehar) nikalta. Daen: K-alpha hf = EL - EK; K-beta hf = EM - EK (zyada tawanai); tawanaiyan target ki dhaat par munhasir, is liye lakeerein characteristic X-rays hain.
blocks.caption: Andaruni khol ki tabdeeliyan aur characteristic X-rays (Fig 20.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Tez electron ko pehle andaruni khol mein khala banana parta hai. X-ray photon bahar ke electron ke us khala mein girne se aata hai, is liye us ki tawanai target atom ke do khol ke farq se tay hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Khali sheeshe ki tube. Baen garam filament F wala cathode C electrons chhorta, jo tube ke aar-paar unche voltage V se anode ke tungsten target tak tez kiye jate, jis ke saath thanda karne ka block hai. Purple lehrein target se neeche nikalti X-rays dikhati. Unche voltage ki supply cathode aur anode jorti; (K.E.)max = Ve.
blocks.caption: X-ray tube mein X-rays banana (Fig 20.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Electrons unche voltage se Ve tawanai lete aur bhari target mein achanak kho dete hain. Zyada tar tawanai hararat ban jati, isi liye target ko thanda karna parta hai; thora hissa X-rays ban jata hai.

blocks.text: Musalsal spectrum bremsstrahlung, yani braking radiation, ki wajah se hai. Jab tez electrons target se takrate hain to achanak dheeme ho jate hain, aur raftar badalta (dheema hota) charge electromagnetic shuaein chhorta hai. Raftar ki kami itni zyada hai ke shuaon ki wavelength chhoti, X-ray ki had mein, hoti hai. Agar electron pehli takkar mein apni tamam kinetic energy kho de to woh sab aik X-ray photon ban jati hai jis ki tawanai h f_max hai: (K.E.)max = h f_max. Yeh Fig 20.6 ki sab se chhoti wavelength, lambda_min, hai jo eV = hc/lambda_min se milti hai. Doosre electrons kai takkaron mein tawanai khote hain, jis se kam tawanai (lambi wavelength) ke photons bante aur musalsal spectrum banta hai.

blocks.alt: Wavelength ke muqable X-ray ki shiddat ka graph. Neela musalsal spectrum kam se kam wavelength lambda-min se neeche sifar, tezi se chauri chotti tak uth kar lambi wavelengths par ahista girta. Do tez surkh lakeerein, K-beta aur K-alpha, curve se oopar uthti. Neeche: eV = h f_max = hc/lambda_min.
blocks.caption: X-ray spectrum: bremsstrahlung aur characteristic lakeerein (Fig 20.6 ke mutabiq asal graph).
blocks.long_description: Hamwar curve dheeme hote electrons se aata hai; lambda-min par us ka tez khatma tube ke voltage se tay hota hai. Nukeeli chotiyan andaruni khol ki tabdeeliyon se aati aur target ki dhaat se tay hoti hain.

blocks.text: Jism se guzarte hue X-rays atoms se amal kar ke tawanai khoti hain; ise attenuation kehte hain. X-rays atoms ko ionise kar ke electrons nikal sakti hain, isi tarah tawanai muntaqil hoti hai. Shua ki shiddat maddah ki motai ke saath exponential tor par ghatti hai: I = Io e^(-mu x), jahan Io ibtidai shiddat, I maddah se guzarne ke baad shiddat, x motai (metre mein) aur mu attenuation coefficient hai, jo maddah aur X-ray ki tawanai par munhasir hai. Usi waqt ki X-ray imaging (fluoroscopy) mein image intensifiers use hote hain; yeh tasveer roshan kar ke shuaon ka samna kam karte hain.

blocks.title: Contrast
blocks.text: X-ray tasveer mein contrast yeh hai ke mukhtalif tissues kitni wazahat se alag pehchane ja sakte hain. Yeh is par munhasir hai ke tissues X-rays ko kitna mukhtalif jazb karte hain, jo un ki density, motai aur atomic number, aur X-ray ki tawanai par munhasir hai.

Sakht (hard) X-rays (zyada tawanai) haddiyon ki tasveer ke liye use hoti hain; naram (soft) X-rays (kam tawanai) breast jaise naram tissues ke liye behtar hain. Contrast media iodine (Z = 53) ya barium (Z = 56) jaise maddey hain jo X-rays ko achhi tarah jazb karte hain; inhein jism ke khaas hisse numayan karne ke liye injection se diya ya nigla jata hai. Zyada atomic number ki wajah se yeh X-ray ki jazbiyat barha kar un tissues ko saaf numayan karte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: Io se shuru hone wale motai ke muqable shiddat ke graphs; naram tissue (chhota mu) ka curve ahista aur haddi (bara mu) ka tezi se girta; I = Io e^(-mu x). Daen: mutawazi X-rays haddi ke tukre wale tissue ke tukre se guzar kar film par parti; film tissue ke neeche gehri aur haddi ke neeche halki; iodine aur barium jaise contrast media naram aza numayan karte.
blocks.caption: X-ray imaging mein attenuation aur contrast (asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Haddi naram tissue se kaheen zyada shua jazb karti hai, is liye us ke neeche film tak kam X-rays pohanchti aur woh halka saya dikhti hai. Taqreeban barabar jazb karne wale tissues kam contrast dete hain jab tak contrast medium na dala jaye.

blocks.title: Attenuation ka formula
blocks.text: Kitab attenuation ka qanoon I = Io x e^(-mu x) chhapti hai, jis mein 'x' motai se zarb jaisa lagta hai. Durust shakal I = Io e^(-mu x) hai: motai sirf exponent mein aati hai.

blocks.prompt: 50 kV par chalne wali tube se X-rays ki kam se kam wavelength maloom karein.

items: X-ray tube: V se tez electrons bhari target se takrate; (K.E.)max = Ve.
Characteristic lakeerein: K-alpha = EL - EK, K-beta = EM - EK; lambda_min = hc/eV tak musalsal bremsstrahlung.
I = Io e^(-mu x); mukhtalif jazbiyat se contrast; iodine aur barium contrast media.
